overview_description.description:
We are the node that connects knowledge.

Knowde is the leading software platform for the chemical industry. Built on the world's largest, purpose-built chemical taxonomy, Knowde’s software powers digital transformation for global chemical producers and distributors to unlock new possibilities in chemical operations. The company is backed by notable investors including Sequoia Capital, Coatue, and sixteen other venture funds. Learn more at knowde.com.

about_short_description.short_description: The leading software platform for the chemical industry.

product.name: Knowde AI
product.description: A data processing system that extracts, structures, harmonizes, and enriches chemical industry data from various sources to create a clean, unified data set.

product.name: Knowde MDM Platform
product.description: A centralized master data management platform that stores and manages clean, structured chemical industry data for use across enterprise systems.

product.name: Knowde CXP
product.description: A customer experience platform integrated with master data management, enabling chemical companies to deploy complex digital storefronts on their websites.

product.name: Knowde Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace platform where chemical companies can create storefronts to digitally trade and expand their reach within the industry.
